finding: Qwen3.8's 1.054 ms/step 'unattributed residual' is NOT unmeasured. The runtime already measures it and the harness throws it away.

evidence.runtime_struct: crates/hawking-core/src/metal/mod.rs CommandBufferTiming carries submit_ns, wait_ns, gpu_ns, dispatches AND encode_ns
evidence.harness: crates/hawking-core/src/model/qwen38_hybrid_decode.rs records only gpu_ns: Vec<Option<u64>> and wait_ns: Vec<u64> per step. encode_ns and submit_ns are returned by commit_and_wait_timed and then dropped.
evidence.arithmetic: wall 1068.1 ms - sum(wait) 1041.7 ms = 26.4 ms over 26 steps = 1.054 ms/step, which is exactly the window in which encoding and submission happen: after one commit_and_wait returns and before the next one is entered.

ruled_out.host_sampling: Sampling is ON-DEVICE - the harness reads a single u32 via workspace.sampled.contents(). There is no host argmax over the 248,320 vocabulary, so sampling cannot be the residual.
ruled_out.token_bookkeeping: tokens.push and Vec growth are nanosecond-class, not millisecond-class.

why_it_matters: This 1.415 ms of fixed per-token overhead (0.361 wait-gap + 1.054 residual) does NOT scale with BPW, so it bounds the density ladder: 2.0 BPW -> 58.2 TPS, 1.25 BPW -> 88.7 TPS. RUNG B (>=100 TPS) is unreachable by density alone and needs this overhead cut too.
the_fix_is_small: Record encode_ns and submit_ns per step alongside gpu_ns/wait_ns. That converts the residual from 'unattributed' to named, which is exactly what G001's closure requirement demands.
then_the_real_question: If the residual IS encode, the mechanism is S004 s7 items 8/9/13 - make CPU-generated metadata persistent GPU state, collapse command buffers, move tables into function constants. Indirect Command Buffers are the known lever on this machine: prior work recorded per-dispatch overhead being won by elimination into ICB.
